description: This file is a shell script library designed for testing credential handling in Git. It includes helper functions for checking credential helpers, cleaning residual data, and testing various credential storage scenarios such as store, retrieve, overwrite, and erase credentials, along with handling long headers, timeouts, password expiry, OAuth tokens, and authtype capabilities.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Simulates a credential helper operation by reading input, executing the git credential command, and comparing the output against expected results.

methods.name: read_chunk
methods.description: Reads input lines until a delimiter '--' and outputs each line.

methods.name: helper_test_clean
methods.description: Cleans residual credential data before running credential tests.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects a specified credential for a given protocol, host, and username.

methods.name: helper_test
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive series of tests on a credential helper, including store, retrieve, overwrite, erase, and handling of long headers and multiple users.

methods.name: helper_test_timeout
methods.description: Tests credential helper behavior under timeout conditions.

methods.name: helper_test_password_expiry_utc
methods.description: Tests storing, retrieving, and overwriting password expiry timestamps.

methods.name: helper_test_oauth_refresh_token
methods.description: Tests storing and retrieving OAuth refresh tokens.

methods.name: helper_test_authtype
methods.description: Tests storing and retrieving authtype and credentials, including handling of ephemeral credentials.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Creates a simple shell script for prompting and echoing user inputs.
